profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, New York, with 2024 revenue of $67.535 billion. The company describes itself as offering IBM OpenPages, a scalable, AI-powered unified governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform available on any cloud or on-premises deployment. OpenPages features an interactive GRC Canvas for visualizing and managing risk with live data, embedded AI that automates classification and issue creation, and modular components tailored to specific risk and compliance domains.

IBM's AI governance offerings include IBM OpenPages with Watson, which integrates risk assessment and regulatory mapping with Watson AI for automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, an AI lifecycle governance product for model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation that was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. Both products leverage IBM watsonx, the company's enterprise AI platform, which provides model-agnostic capabilities including agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection.

The company emphasizes flexible integration, allowing organizations to connect IBM, third-party, or custom AI models through API-based architecture to avoid vendor lock-in. OpenPages includes an MCP Server that securely enables AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects for governed automation. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape for AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance in 2026, and the company notes that Citi partnered with IBM to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning.
